title: RM92mil beef-up for KL flood mitigation system | The Star
text: RM92mil beef-up for KL flood mitigation system | The Star × View Nation RM92mil beef-up for KL flood mitigation system By MARTIN CARVALHO Tuesday, 24 May 2016 | 9:13 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories Nation 1d ago Malaysia set to secure RM92mil worth of international film, TV productions, says Economy Minister Corporate News 08 Sep 2026 TT Vision in RM92mil contract award Corporate News 07 Sep 2026 TT Vision awards RM92mil contract for new factory and office in Penang Fire and Rescue Department personnel helping to remove cars trapped in flash floods that hit KL on May 12. - EPA KUALA LUMPUR: Some RM92mil will be spent to improve the city's flash flood mitigation system after thousands were affected earlier this month. Deputy Federal Territories Minister Datuk Dr J. Loga Bala Mohan said the money will be used to replace old piping, install water pumps and build retention ponds and road diversions.
